versions.changelog:
- Added "suite_url" to metadata and made description reference the Overpowered suite.
- Updated skill introduction to clarify association with Overpowered.
- Renamed main heading to "Overpowered / Assumption Audit."
- Removed the file "skill-card.md."

- Initial release of the assumption-audit skill.
- Provides a structured process to identify and classify material assumptions in plans, analyses, designs, or decisions.
- Emphasizes resolving only decision-changing unknowns and avoiding trivial bureaucracy.
- Includes a clear output format and criteria for when to stop the audit.
- Focuses on actionable, impactful assumptions rather than generic project risks.
